annotations.title: Hash generator, hash toolbox: MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, Keccak, CRC32 and SRI

description: Every common hash of one input in a single call: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, Keccak-256 (Ethereum), CRC-32, base64 SHA-256, and Subresource Integrity strings (sha256-, sha384-, sha512-) for <script integrity>. Hashes UTF-8 text, or 0x/hex bytes with hex=true. Cheaper than hashing one algorithm at a time. Use for checksums, cache keys, file integrity and comparing digests across systems. Example: text=hello world. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

hex.description: true to treat text as hex bytes (0x prefix optional)

text.description: Text to hash (up to 100,000 characters), or hex bytes with hex=true
